subject: Dedicated capacity — throughput & pricing follow-up
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Park <lena.park@fluxhealth.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 Oct 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated capacity — follow-up & sizing questions

Hi Lena,

Thanks for the call earlier — great overview of Flux Health's clinical triage + summarization use cases. Per our discussion, a few clarifying questions so we can firm up a dedicated capacity proposal: 

- Monthly token volume estimate: you mentioned a 400M–900M token range depending on uptake. Can you confirm the most-likely scenario for Q1 production?
- Target unit economics: do you have a target $/1M tokens (range) we should price toward for a reserved lane offering?
- GPU preference: you flagged latency as critical — do you want us to size the proposal around H100-only lanes, or is A100 acceptable if we combine with caching?
- Throughput / concurrency: please confirm expected peak concurrent requests and avg tokens per response (so we can size KV-cache and lane count).
- Timeline & procurement contact: who should receive the SOW/PO drafts? I’ve cc'd Marissa for pricing/legal handoff.

Attached: redwood-dedicated-quote-v1.pdf (draft, illustrative numbers only).

If you prefer, we can do a 30-min procurement + infra sizing call Thurs.

Next steps I suggest:
- You confirm the bullet answers above
- We send 2 pricing options (H100 lane baseline; A100 alternative)
- Pilot proposal + procurement template

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

— Stephanie

On Tue, Oct 19, 2027 at 3:12 PM Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Lena,
> 
> Thanks for the call earlier — great overview of Flux Health's clinical triage + summarization use cases. Per our discussion, a few clarifying questions so we can firm up a dedicated capacity proposal: 
> ...

Thanks, Stephanie — good recap. Answers below so you can update the draft: 

- Most-likely monthly token volume (Q1 production): 500M tokens (conservative); optimistic scenario ~900M if we run paid beta + marketing push.
- Unit economics target: we’re ideally targeting $30–45 per 1M tokens for the dedicated/reserved offering (we need to hit the lower end for an internal ROI threshold).
- GPU preference: H100 preferred due to latency and longer context runs; we would accept A100 if unit economics are materially better and you can prove parity on our tail-latency SLA.
- Throughput / concurrency: peak concurrent requests ~6–9 (7 median), avg tokens per response ~650–750 tokens. Peak sustained tokens/day estimate ~20–30M (peak days), average ~15–20M/day.
- Timeline & procurement: procurement@fluxhealth.ai is the right contact. Targeting pilot start the week of Nov 8; procurement will need a simple SOW + PO template.

Attaching our procurement checklist: flux_po_requirements.pdf.

Happy to do the sizing call Thursday — but if you can send two clean options (H100 baseline + A100 alternate) with explicit $/1M math, we can circulate to procurement for a quick buy-in.

Thanks,
Lena
Lena Park
Head of Product
Flux Health
lena.park@fluxhealth.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Park <lena.park@fluxhealth.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 Oct 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity — follow-up & sizing questions

Thanks for the details, Lena — helpful. I put together two concrete options (assumptions and math attached in dedicated-econ-options-v2.pdf). Key highlights: 

Option A — H100 reserved lane (baseline)
- Assumptions: 1x H100 reserved lane sized for 25M tokens/day peak (KV cache & batching tuned for 700 token responses, avg latency SLA 250–350ms).
- Monthly list for lane: $14,500 (includes reserved compute + baseline support).
- With expected 500M tokens/month (Q1 conservative) this equates to ~ $29 / 1M tokens.
- Pros: tail latency, easiest path to meet your SLA; straightforward scale to 2 lanes for growth.

Option B — A100 banded lanes (cost-optimized)
- Assumptions: 2x A100 lanes with smart routing + heavier batching; lower peak throughput per lane than H100.
- Monthly list for lanes: $11,000 (for both lanes combined).
- With 500M tokens/month this equates to ~ $38 / 1M tokens.
- Pros: lower monthly commitment; Cons: riskier for tail-latency-sensitive workloads and requires more caching fine-tuning.

Pilot path suggestion:
- Start with Option A (1x H100 lane) as a 6-week pilot: we can cap usage to the 500M token conservative plan and measure real-world token mix. If average usage stays below 250M over pilot we can consider A100 conversion.
- We can include a one-time migration credit if you commit to a 12mo reserved plan after the pilot.

Next actions I propose:
- Stephanie: send a redlined pilot SOW + 2-option pricing sheet to procurement@fluxhealth.ai (I attached dedicated-econ-options-v2.pdf).
- Lena / procurement: confirm PO approver + expected PO date (you mentioned Oct 28 in call).
- Schedule a 30-min procurement handoff w/ our legal + infra (I’m available Thurs or Mon morning PST).

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/FLX-2027-174
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-fluxhealth-dedicated

— Marissa

We’ll move forward with the 6-week pilot on the H100 baseline (Option A). Procurement will draft a PO and target Oct 28 to send the initial purchase request. Procurement has the drive folder and checklist; they’ll reach out to schedule the legal + infra handoff next week.

Please include any SOW language for acceptance criteria (latency / token accounting / data retention) in the pilot draft.

Lena
